description: This file defines a Java Swing UI component called RpmCommand, which provides a spinner control for setting a RPM value. It includes a method to request an RPM change by sending a command through a CommandQueue.

classes.name: RpmCommand
classes.description: A Swing JPanel component that allows users to set RPM via a spinner control.

methods.name: RpmCommand
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UI components for RPM control.

methods.name: requestRpmChange
methods.description: Static method to send RPM change command via CommandQueue.
